interpretation: Nonnegative constant sensor fields support close agreement of the explicit synthetic DNG calibration transform. Negative constant sensor fields and balanced noisy black fields exhibit a strong oracle positive-camera bias consistent with clipping before calibration. The full Sony ARW blue discrepancy is not thereby completely resolved, and production signed handling is unchanged.
